name: card_not_present_fraud

trigger.description: Card-not-present fraud detected on ACC-10023. Customer's debit card used for 7 online purchases totaling $3,847.50 across e-commerce merchants in a 2-hour window. Customer confirms they did not make these purchases. Card data likely compromised via skimming or data breach.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: detect fraud pattern, investigate card compromise source, freeze card and issue replacement, initiate chargebacks for all 7 transactions, file report.

name: wire_fraud_bec

trigger.description: Business Email Compromise (BEC) wire fraud reported by commercial customer. Controller at Apex Manufacturing (ACC-10067) received spoofed email appearing to be from the company CFO instructing a $187,500 wire transfer to 'new vendor' account at overseas bank. Wire was executed 2 hours ago and funds have not yet settled at beneficiary bank.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: verify fraud, initiate immediate wire recall via SWIFT MT192, freeze outbound wires on account, investigate email compromise, file SAR, generate report.

name: structuring_detection

trigger.description: Structuring pattern detected on ACC-10042. Customer Viktor Petrov made 8 cash deposits over 3 days, each between $8,500 and $9,900, totaling $74,200. Deposits made at 5 different branch locations. Pattern consistent with deliberate avoidance of $10,000 Currency Transaction Report threshold.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: confirm structuring pattern, investigate fund sources and graph connections, place AML hold on account, file SAR with FinCEN, compile audit trail.

name: synthetic_identity_fraud

trigger.description: Synthetic identity fraud suspected on recently opened account ACC-10091. KYC review flagged inconsistencies: SSN belongs to a minor, address is a commercial mail receiving agency, employer cannot be verified. Account was opened 45 days ago with $500 deposit and has since received $22,000 in ACH credits from 3 different payroll processors.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: verify identity documents, check external fraud databases for synthetic identity indicators, freeze account, file SAR for identity fraud, notify credit bureaus.

name: check_kiting_scheme

trigger.description: Check kiting pattern detected between two accounts held at our institution. ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 (both owned by Coastal Ventures LLC) are exchanging checks in a circular pattern, artificially inflating balances. Over the past 10 days, 14 checks totaling $156,000 have been exchanged between the accounts. Both accounts show negative collected balances but positive ledger balances due to float exploitation.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: confirm kiting pattern via transaction analysis, investigate business legitimacy, place hold on both accounts, process chargebacks for uncollected items, file SAR, compile audit report.
